en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a vast Turkish cemetery with numerous irregular gravestones spread across an open field. A seated man in period attire appears in the foreground among the tombstones. In the distance are low buildings and a tree‑lined horizon. The caption at the top in French reads "SALONIQUE — Le Cimetière Turc," and there is a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom right.
